title: City College moved $6.7 million into its workers’ compensation fund after two deficits

beats.text: City College set money aside for workers’ compensation claims.

visual.sub: A claims fund fell below zero

beats.text: By June 2020 the fund owed more than it held.

visual.kicker: A claims fund fell below zero

beats.text: A year later its deficit reached about $3.9 million.
Estimated claims were a separate balance sheet liability.

visual.kicker: The deficit nearly doubled in one year

beats.text: The auditors warned the general fund might have to help.

visual.kicker: A claims fund fell below zero

beats.text: The actual transfer report shows about $6.7 million.
It moved from the unrestricted fund to the self-insurance fund.

visual.kicker: The district reported an actual unrestricted transfer

beats.text: Local revenue and outgo also changed the year-end result.
The fund ended the year around $4.0 million above zero.
The following audit marked the recommendation implemented.

visual.kicker: The year-end filing and next audit show the outcome

beats.text: The later audit showed the fund still held over four million dollars.

visual.kicker: The year-end filing and next audit show the outcome

beats.text: It reported no improper claim and no payment to an outside party in this finding.

visual.kicker: The year-end filing and next audit show the outcome
